test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Cricket : 11 :: Kabaddi : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

 
• In the Cricket game, there are 11 players in each team. So, 11 is related to cricket.
 
• Similarly, the Kabaddi game has 7 players in each team. So, 7 related to kabaddi.

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.
